== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[The Republic No Longer Functions (Errata 2)]]: the PC card image of [[The Republic No Longer Functions (Errata)]] (22 July 2024, holotable 6c22b09, scaled to the slip width) beside the partial slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (page 2). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
